title: finding(console): `FormPage` reads no `widget` key at all, so an authored `widget` is silently dropped on `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` — and three widget keys are reachable ONLY through it
body:
## The finding

`@objectstack/spec` declares `widget` as an optional string on a field, and the shared chain **reads it**:

- `packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` carries `fd.widget`;
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` resolves `f?.widget || f?.field?.widget || f?.type`.

Three widget keys — **`object-ref`, `filter-condition`, `recipient-picker`** — are reachable **only** through that key.

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` reads no `widget` key at all: its switch is keyed on `field.type` alone, and after objectui#10167 every occurrence of the word in that file is in a comment. ⇒ an authored `widget` is **silently dropped** on the `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes, and the three keys above cannot be reached there at all.

## Why this is its own card rather than a row of the consolidation question

⚠️ The dev that measured it flagged that a PM might prefer to fold it in, and the reason not to is specific: **`widget` is a second axis.** 「Add the missing arms」 would close the type axis and leave this one entirely open — a renderer with all 49 type arms would still drop every authored `widget`. ⇒ folding it in would let the consolidation card be 「closed」 while this defect survives.

⛔ It is also independently fixable: `FormPage` could read `widget` ahead of `type` without any architectural decision.

Seam: `spec:Field.widget` → renderer `apps/console` `FormPage` `FieldInput`. Consumer: `sys_sharing_rule`-style admin forms (ADR-0056 P2) rendered on a FormView.

## Provenance and radius

Measured by the dev on objectui#10167, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat. Radius: the two named read sites and a grep of `FormPage.tsx`. ⛔ Outside: whether any shipped metadata authors those three keys on a FormView today.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`). ⛔ Filed bare.

## Dedupe words

`FormPage ignores field widget override` · `widget hint object-ref filter-condition recipient-picker second renderer` · `declared widget key dropped console form` · `switch keyed on type blind to widget axis`
